ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  AAA Technologies Limited announced the resignation of its Chairman and Managing Director, Mr. Venugopal Dhoot, effective August 31, 2026. This significant leadership change is a direct consequence of an executed Share Purchase Agreement (SPA) and a contemplated change in company ownership and control. While the departure of a key executive due to a change of control is a material event requiring investor attention regarding future strategic direction, the document indicates a non-contentious transition with no other material reasons cited.
